value.rationale: This answers a natural existence-spectrum problem prompted by a new categorical fan criterion: precisely Picard rank five is excluded among all smooth complete toric surfaces, whereas arbitrarily high ranks occur even when K^2 is arbitrarily negative. The sharp one-gap phenomenon is a geometric boundary, not a mere explicit instance or routine reparametrization; the infinite construction explains how tensor-generation persists well beyond weak-Fano positivity.
